title: I created the entire music track for my game with AI
author: Weak_Sugar_5757
selftext:
I just finished all the songs that will make up the saundoniA soundtrack in 100% of the process. 

I intend to release my game later this year, something I should worry about having used ai?

comments.author: ArmandoGalvez
comments.body: Do you have a tool to make SFX by any chance?

comments.author: meowsaygames
comments.body: Yes, it's possible. However, anything related to AI will be considered garbage by some extreme players. So, just use it discreetly and don't publicly announce to the player community that you're using AI.

replies.author: Darhkwing
replies.body: but what happens if the game really takes off and then whens awards or something? That's my only concern. My game uses music ive created with suno , ive had a lot of good response to it.. but still, concerned.

replies.author: meowsaygames
replies.body:
Honestly, I think you're worrying too far ahead.

First, finish the game. Then release it.

Most games never even reach the “award-winning success” stage, so don't let hypothetical future problems stop you from creating something now.

If the game actually becomes successful, you'll have way more options later to improve, replace, or polish things if needed.

Right now, the most important thing is simply shipping the game.

comments.author: drx_runner_x
comments.body: It's good, but i think it should be more careful and mindful to use it due to risk to be considered or labeled in negative way, but yeah in my opinion you could! :)

comments.author: Extra-Yard-7458
comments.body: Don’t say anything, if someone questions you on it then lie

replies.author: Weak_Sugar_5757
replies.body: The problem with doing this is that Steam identifies it through the song's SynthID and could ban me from the platform.

comments.author: Sufficient_Gap_3029
comments.body: Ai created art/music cannot be copyrighted so someone can literally take your music and reupload it for commercial usage.

comments.author: prosthost1
comments.body: Do you mind sharing the track?

comments.author: Automatic_Simple9191
comments.body: I personally would use like a simple music generator or something to make game music. I know that Itch io has tons of great game dev tools like music creation for free or cheap. If your game is a web browser and your using react script or tsx script, you can use beeps sound libraries. I know that last one is not the one but I’m putting there for others to see for reference. -Icer

comments.author: Alternative-Suit5541
comments.body:
Man, just spend ten dollars on patron, search for music you want, get like fifty songs and you are good to go, just check if you can use the songs commercially.


No need for AI

comments.author: Independent-Ad5975
comments.body: Eu uso AI para me auxiliar na produção musical no quesito de instrumental. Mas eu crio toda a melodia e letra pelo SUNO. Tbm gosto de criar demos no garage band antes para ter uma base sólida. O SUNO Studio tbm é uma boa opção para edição musical, mas sai mais caro.
